225-3525-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-3525-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
225-3525-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat from step 1

4770-4885-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4316-5078-7292-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1626-3249-4289--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1626-3249-4289--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Headless Rider triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that Zombie from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.
728-1626-3249-4289--206.notes: Some of the one-drop Zombie creatures in the template adds more powerful results, and Gravecrawler does not require Havengul Lich.

1651-2097-4231-4732-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-2097-4231-4732-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Jolene.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3330-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3330-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4222-4289-7938.description:
Activate Shuttle Ace by tapping it, adding {U}.
Shuttle Ace triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Shuttle Ace.
Repeat.

1308-5658-6245-7824.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
1308-5658-6245-7824.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
1308-5658-6245-7824.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, X-23 triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on X-23 and the other Mutant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
6797-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

1733-3617-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Nephalia Smuggler.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

225-1170-6071-7529.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
225-1170-6071-7529.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core.
Activate Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}. 
Cast the copy of Rampant Growth from exile by paying {1}{G}, unpreparing Studious First-Year.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year, which enters prepared.
Resolve Rampant Growth, fetching a basic land from your library to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
225-1170-6071-7529.notes: You must have at least three permanent cards in your graveyard for this combo to add near-infinite mana.

224-4426-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-4426-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull is a creature and has at least two charge counters on it.
224-4426-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Hearthhull
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-3259-4373.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2366-2511-4452-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2511-4452-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1940-3693-5220.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Walking Ballista from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Walking Ballista from your library.
Repeat.

1115-2525-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1129-2816.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Harabaz Druid.
1129-2816.notablePrerequisites: Harabaz Druid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three Allies.
1129-2816.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Harabaz Druid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2486-5686--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2486-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

141-3645-5231.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2724-4006-5780.notablePrerequisites: Wormfang Manta doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-4006-5780.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Gossip's Talent. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Liliana, Heretical Healer // Liliana, Defiant Necromancer

136-2393-2945-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cadaver Imp, adding {B}.
Cadaver Imp dies, triggering Sifter of Skulls and Liliana, Heretical Healer.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Liliana, Heretical Healer trigger, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield transformed, and creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Liliana, Defiant Necromancer's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it.
Liliana, Defiant Necromancer is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Liliana, Defiant Necromancer ability, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cadaver Imp enters the battlefield, returning Liliana, Heretical Healer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and the Eldrazi Scion tokens, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Liliana, Heretical Healer by paying {1}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1518-1964-1987-3227.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1964-1987-3227.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

4812-5276.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, exiling Animate Dead.
Animate Dead leaves the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Leonin Relic-Warder.
Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, returning Animate Dead from exile to the battlefield.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat from step 3.
